scene_purpose: Let Caelora arrive as a functioning capital before the royal-seal mystery begins; establish lawful routine entry under Maevra's authority; preserve Cyanis's possession of the Card and Torren's copied western-mural evidence; give the player a short first stretch inside the city where the party can register that the Ancient city shown on the mural was substantially larger than modern Caelora without explaining why.

scene_context_seed.location_name: Caelora Gate and first controlled city stretch
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Caelora is functioning, populated, secure and governed. The gate is routine procedure, not an obstacle or detention beat. In the city/town presentation, relevant party members may be visible as field models. Keep gate processing concise and non-suspicious. A short walking exchange after entry is legal because Maevra is actively guiding the group to the palace. Do not begin the royal-seal mystery in Beat 1.

required_story_beats: Caelora is allowed a clean visual arrival before dialogue density begins.
The party enters through a normal functioning gate checkpoint under Maevra's legitimate Crown authority.
No one detains the party or attempts to seize Cyanis's Card.
The player receives a short first controlled stretch inside Caelora before the palace handoff.
Torren may make one bounded practical comparison between modern Caelora and the larger Ancient city shown on the copied mural.
No character explains why the exact Yahtrean Crest appears on the Ancient material.
Beat ends by handing directly into the royal audience/report.
